items.title: Harden native cart failure recovery and state synchronization
items.userValue: Customers receive a clear failure and can safely retry without wrong quantities or duplicate additions.
items.baseline: Native notification, /cart/change and 422 recovery exist; transport rejection in product-form catch logs an error without invoking its visible error handler.
scope: Reproduce transport rejection, malformed/failed section response and stale navigation state
Correct only demonstrated error/retry defects using native endpoints and fragments
acceptanceCriteria: Selected Variant/quantity submits once
Transport failure produces a visible announced error and restores operable controls
422 update preserves last successful quantity and line ownership
Back/forward and section refresh show server cart state
verification: Existing J0 fixtures plus live isolated success/cleanup
Inject rejected fetch and invalid response without contacting cart backend

items.title: Make active cart notification and page controls readable and accessible
items.userValue: Keyboard and enlarged-text customers can inspect items and reach native checkout.
items.baseline: J0 reproduces populated cart overflow to 504px at 360px/390px under 200% root text, with quantity right edge 494px. Active notification/focus recovery and desktop cart pass. No J0 runtime source change.
scope: Correct only evidenced cart-specific focus, announcement or clipping defects
Keep notification and full cart coherent with native control labeling
acceptanceCriteria: 360/390/1440 and 200% text remain usable
Escape closes dialog and returns focus
Hidden dialog controls never receive focus
Item/Variant link names and subtotal remain readable
Serious/critical storefront findings fail acceptance; inherited C/F/provider findings retain separate ownership
verification: Native modal, Product and gallery regression

items.title: Consume approved equipment delivery context in the cart
items.userValue: Machine buyers see accurate delivery context without an invented freight quote.
items.baseline: Native shipping/tax note exists; shipping profile/rate/pickup/lead-time policy is not verified by J0.
scope: After K approval, render minimal exact-Product logistics context and approved contact route
Preserve mixed machine/consumable line identities and native checkout
acceptanceCriteria: Each message binds approved exact Product authority
Missing/expired authority suppresses optional content without disabling native cart
Mixed carts retain quantities/prices
No unsupported free freight/pickup/lead-time claim

items.title: Add approved optional notes and purchase support guidance
items.userValue: Customers can supply useful instructions or reach the approved contact channel.
items.baseline: Native cart-note implementation exists but show_cart_note is false; no approved PO/tax-exempt workflow.
scope: Enable/configure optional native notes only after owner disposition
Use approved L service/contact resources for PO or tax-exempt guidance
acceptanceCriteria: Notes save/reload using /cart/update and error recovery
Optional note does not gate checkout
Approved resources are accessible; missing resource omitted

items.title: Apply explicitly approved Product-level commercial dispositions
items.userValue: Affected buyers receive an accurate owner-approved disposition.
items.baseline: MR16 and generic Saw Vice are native $0.00 with enabled purchase; neither free sale nor a hold is approved.
scope: After G006 decisions, implement only exact Product/Variant actions and approved wording
Keep pricing, policy and compatibility authority separate
acceptanceCriteria: No action without exact Product-level authority
Unaffected zero-price fixture remains native
Authorized disposition is tested across Product and cart entry paths
No account requirement or inferred compatibility
verification: Positive exact-authority and missing/mismatched/expired authority negatives

items.title: Clarify approved discount and accelerated checkout entry
items.userValue: Customers understand native checkout choices without misleading payment promises.
items.baseline: Product dynamic checkout is disabled; cart footer has conditional provider-supplied accelerated controls and discount application display, not a custom code form.
scope: Retain native checkout unless owner approves a specific placement change
Explain approved discount workflow through existing eligible surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Current Basic entitlement is verified
Provider controls appear only when Shopify supplies them
Keyboard-visible standard checkout remains available
No fake discount or financing claim
verification: Native checkout visibility and non-submission guard

items.title: Prepare bounded cart relationship guidance if approved
items.userValue: Customers receive precise relationship guidance without a false compatibility claim.
items.baseline: Approved fit is lease-bound; current G2 presentation is expired. Native Related products is separate.
scope: Define an opt-in exact-relationship consumer after G003 operating policy and owner copy approval
acceptanceCriteria: Expired/incomplete/unpublished authority suppresses guidance
Native buying survives relationship expiry
Compatible/included/optional/recommended retain separate meanings
verification: Reuse G1/G2 exact-set and lifecycle negatives

items.title: Validate integrated cart handoff and release boundaries
items.userValue: A reviewed cart change has reproducible technical evidence and explicit launch limitations.
items.baseline: J0 supplies baseline tooling and protected-state checks; production and K/L/G release decisions remain separate.
scope: Re-run accepted implemented PBI paths using J0 tools
Verify source/plan/current inventories, accessibility and bounded performance
Create reviewed file allowance and rollback only in a separately authorized deployment batch
acceptanceCriteria: All reviewed MVP technical criteria pass with exact logs/cleanup
Optional unapproved features are deferred rather than false failures
Commercial, K/L operational and production authorization remain distinct
Historical evidence and MAIN/unrelated preview bytes remain unchanged
verification: npm.cmd run validate:epic-j-j0 with fresh isolated evidence
Theme Check, Product/machine regressions and read-only inventories
